verdict.rationale: Exa documents that its MCP server is open source and available on GitHub ('Free and open-source'), and its exa-js SDK is published on GitHub. These are peripheral components, though; the core search index and API service has no evidence of open source code, and no specific license is named. missing for 10: open-source availability of the core search/index product, a named OSI license for any repo, evidence that the SDK repos are openly licensed.
